title: The zpa_service_edge_group resource for Private Service Edge groups

prose.text: The provider models a Private Service Edge group as one resource and Private Service Edge instances only as a data source.

prose.label: Arguments.
prose.text: {{tf-required-args}} {{zpa-terraform-grace}} Only the first trusted_networks block is sent {{divergence:trusted-networks-max-items}}. Wrapper modules: [[zpa.private-service-edges.reference-modules]].

prose.label: Import and managed groups.
prose.text: {{import-by-id-or-name}} {{managed-flags}} Importing a managed group is unverified {{gap:import-managed-group}}.

Provider defects: [[zpa.terraform.resource-fidelity]], [[zpa.terraform.data-source-fidelity]], and first-block-only association reads in [[zpa.terraform.app-segment-lifecycle:association-block-first-only-places]]. Enrollment fields: [[zpa.private-service-edges.enrollment]].
Service edge membership drift is hidden unless service_edges is configured {{service-edges-diff-suppressed-when-unset}}.
A grace distance differing past one decimal produces no diff {{grace-distance-value-one-decimal}}.

checks.do: Whether a configuration manages membership: when service_edges is omitted Terraform ignores membership entirely, so drift in members is not reported.
Whether the plan sets grace_distance_enabled without the value and unit, which the schema rejects.
Whether a group Terraform wants to change is Zscaler-managed, which is read only.
Whether the data source returning an empty Private Service Edge list is the provider defect rather than an empty group.

tf-required-args.statement: In the resource schema, name, latitude, longitude and location are required, city_country is optional and country_code is optional and computed, although the provider docs list city_country and country_code under Required. enabled defaults to true and is_public to false.

quotes: `city_country` - (String) The city and country of the App Connector

tf-required-args.conditions: Statement changed from the legacy "requires name, latitude, longitude, location, city_country and country_code": the schema marks city_country Optional and country_code Optional+Computed, contradicting the docs' Required list. Dropped "trusted_networks takes at most one block": the schema's MaxItems is commented out, so that is now the trusted-networks-max-items divergence; the defaults are now cited from the schema.

zpa-terraform-grace.statement: grace_distance_value and grace_distance_value_unit are RequiredWith grace_distance_enabled in the schema, and each is RequiredWith the other, so setting either value or unit requires the other two fields.

service-edges-block.statement: When the service_edges block is omitted Terraform ignores service edge membership completely; when specified it enforces exact membership and reports any discrepancy as drift. Membership is typically managed outside Terraform.

quotes: Terraform will ignore service edge membership completely (no drift detection)
Any discrepancy between configuration and actual state will be reported as drift
Service edge membership is typically managed outside Terraform

service-edges-deprecation.statement: The service_edges block carries a deprecation notice: it will be deprecated in a future release.

quotes: The `service_edges` block will be deprecated in a future release

import-by-id-or-name.statement: A Service Edge group can be imported using its ID or its name as the import ID.

quotes: Service Edge Group can be imported; use `<SERVER EDGE GROUP ID>` or `<SERVER EDGE GROUP NAME>` as the import ID.

managed-flags.statement: The group type carries readOnly and zscalerManaged flags, and Zscaler-managed groups are read only in the console.

quotes: Private Service Edge groups that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited or deleted.

managed-flags.conditions: Inferred link: the flag names match the console's read-only, Zscaler-managed groups; no source states that the flags drive that behavior.

private-cloud-group-enrollment.statement: zpa_private_cloud_group follows the same enrollment pattern: enrollment_cert_id is optional with auto-resolution of the "Connector" certificate by name when omitted, and user_codes enables OAuth2 enrollment.

quotes: Added OAuth2 user code enrollment support to the `zpa_private_cloud_group` resource via the new `user_codes` attribute, and made `enrollment_cert_id` optional with auto-resolution of the `Connector` enrollment certificate by name when omitted.

controller-data-source.statement: The provider has a zpa_service_edge_controller data source that looks up a service edge controller by name, and a service_edge_group resource; the documentation lists no resource for individual Private Service Edge instances.

quotes: Use the **zpa_service_edge_controller** data source to get information about a service edge controller in the Zscaler Private Access cloud.

controller-data-source.conditions: Absence: listing docs/resources at the pin shows zpa_service_edge_group and zpa_service_edge_assistant_schedule but no resource for a single Service Edge instance.

service-edges-diff-suppressed-when-unset.statement: The Terraform Service Edge group resource declares service_edges optional and computed with a warning that membership is managed externally, and suppresses any diff on it unless the field is set in configuration.

quotes: Description: "WARNING: Service edge membership is managed externally. " +
// If the field isn't set in config (regardless of static or dynamic block)

grace-distance-value-one-decimal.statement: The Terraform Service Edge group resource treats grace_distance_value as unchanged when old and new values are equal after formatting to one decimal place.

import-managed-group.title: Importing a Zscaler-managed Private Service Edge group
import-managed-group.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Any Terraform import of such a group will result in a plan that cannot apply ... Do not import Zscaler-managed PSE Groups into Terraform state." The read-only rule is documented in the console; the import and apply outcome is not. Resolve with a lab test.
import-managed-group.blocks: advising whether a managed group may be imported

trusted-networks-max-items.summary: The docs allow one trusted_networks block, but the schema sets no limit and the provider reads only the first block.

positions.says: The resource docs say trusted_networks allows at most one block.

quotes: `trusted_networks` - (Block Set) Trusted networks for this Service Edge Group. List of trusted network objects Maximum 1 block allowed.

positions.says: The schema declares trusted_networks as an optional list with its MaxItems line commented out, so several blocks pass validation.
The expander sends only the IDs in the first trusted_networks block.

trusted-networks-max-items.impact: A configuration with several trusted_networks blocks plans without error, but only the first block's IDs reach the API; put every trusted network ID in one block.
